capabilities: Drag the text column's right margin to resize it
Set width to Narrow, Wide or Max from the status bar
Save the chosen width globally between sessions
extras: Desktop only; the grip and status bar buttons have no effect while Obsidian's 'Readable line length' setting is off. Width range is 400px to pane width; presets are Narrow 700px, Wide 1100px, Max 100%. Install is manual: copy main.js, manifest.json and styles.css into .obsidian/plugins/page-width/.
intentEvidence: Obsidian plugin (desktop only) that sets the readable line width (--file-line-width).
problem: Obsidian's readable line length is a fixed setting, so changing the text column width otherwise means editing CSS by hand.
summary: Plugin that resizes Obsidian's readable text column by dragging its edge or picking Narrow, Wide or Max in the status bar.
